light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the cluttered background stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, the side near the opening a little brighter and cooler, the far corners dimmer. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, small blemishes and uneven tone; hair with stray strands; clothes with real creases, dust and wear. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld home video filmed by a friend with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the room in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural hands; people move naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

anchors.prompt: Same place, same framing and same light: the same yard; in the middle stands a rectangular wooden form of rough pine boards, about one metre by two metres and ten centimetres high, held by short wooden stakes divided in two halves by a middle board, filled with concrete: the near half already washed, showing densely packed wet glistening rounded river pebbles about one to two centimetres across, in mixed natural colours: grey, white, reddish-brown and almost black, the far half still covered with a smooth grey cement paste. He stands at the near edge of the slab holding the green garden hose with a spray gun in one hand, turned toward the camera, the other hand pointing down at the washed wet pebbles, amazed. He wears a faded olive-green work shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the elbows, stained with paint and dust, a worn brown leather work apron over it, dark work trousers and black rubber boots. He wears yellow rubber gloves.

clips.text: Le tiré agua al cemento fresco... y mira lo que apareció.
clips.action: He lifts the hose a little and points at the washed pebbles, talking to the camera, amazed.

clips.text: Hoy lo hacemos juntos, paso a paso: la base, la mezcla, el colado y el lavado.
clips.action: He counts four steps on his fingers while talking.

clips.text: Pero el secreto no es la manguera. El secreto es el momento exacto en que lo lavas.
clips.action: He lifts the hose's spray gun up beside his face, serious.

clips.text: Si te adelantas, lo arruinas. Y si te atrasas, ya no sale. Y ese momento, hoy te enseño a encontrarlo.
clips.action: He steps toward the camera, lowering the hose, serious and a little conspiratorial.

clips.text: Te doy primero la receta completa, así ya la tienes. Y después vamos al detalle de cada paso.
clips.action: He relaxes and talks to the camera with an open hand.

clips.line: ¿Le estás lavando el cemento? Lo vas a arruinar.
clips.who: the older neighbour with the thick grey moustache and the light-blue checked shirt (the third reference image is his face)
clips.voice: in Spanish with a neutral Latin American accent, the gruff, amused voice of a 65-year-old man; the man in the olive shirt does NOT speak
clips.action: The neighbour leans over the wall, alarmed, and shakes his head, raising his hands.
The fan of water spray sweeps across the grey paste from left to right and the wet colourful pebbles appear under it, glistening, splashes flying.
The shovel tips and the heavy wet concrete full of pebbles drops into the form, pebbles rolling.
The straight board slides across the wet concrete, leaving it flat and smooth.
The brush circles under the fine shower and the paste melts away, revealing the colourful pebbles.
The gloved finger presses into the setting concrete and lifts, leaving only a faint print.
The cupped hands open and the colourful pebbles pour down onto the heap, bouncing and clicking.
The rubber boot steps down firmly on the wet pebble surface and grips.
A thin sheet of water flows across the dry pebbles and their colours light up as it passes.
The camera moves slowly toward the finished glistening pebble slab.
The brush pushes too early: a pebble pops out of the soft paste and rolls away, leaving a hole.
The brush scrubs hard on the dry grey surface but nothing comes off, only a little dust.

clips.text: Uno, la base. Sacas la tierra blanda, pones grava, la compactas bien y armas un marco de tablas con una pendiente suave.
clips.action: Gravel pours into the form, is spread and packed flat by the tamper.

clips.text: Dos, la mezcla. Una parte de cemento, dos de arena y tres de piedra redonda de río, medidas con el mismo balde. Poca agua.
clips.action: The shovel turns the sand, cement and pebbles over while water is added, until it is a thick wet mix.

clips.text: Tres. La llenas, la emparejas con una regla de madera y aprietas las piedras con la llana, para que queden apenas tapadas.
clips.action: The wooden float presses the pebbles gently into the fresh concrete.

clips.text: Cuatro. Esperas, y cada tanto haces la prueba en una esquina. Si la pasta sale con el cepillo y la piedra no se mueve, es el momento.
clips.action: The soft brush sweeps the corner, the paste comes off and the pebbles stay firm.

clips.text: Cinco. Lluvia fina de manguera y cepillo suave, hasta que se vea más o menos un tercio de cada piedra. No más.
clips.action: The fine shower and the soft brush move along and the washed colourful part grows.

clips.text: Seis. Al otro día, un lavado final. Y después lo mantienes húmedo y tapado con un plástico, unos siete días.
clips.action: Water is sprinkled on the washed slab and a clear plastic sheet is laid over it.

clips.text: Y siete, si quieres, un sellador, cuando ya secó bien. Esa es la receta. Ahora, lo que hace que te salga bien de verdad.
clips.action: The roller passes a thin clear coat over the pebbles and their colours deepen.
